# Exact lookups: MATCH, VLOOKUP and HLOOKUP find text of the lookup value's length; XMATCH,
# XLOOKUP and LOOKUP do not ask for it.
MATCH("e"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(769),D1:D16,0)
MATCH(_xlfn.UNICHAR(233),D2:D16,0)
MATCH("SS",D5:D16,0)
MATCH(_xlfn.UNICHAR(230),D6:D6,0)
MATCH(_xlfn.UNICHAR(1073),D1:D16,0)
MATCH(_xlfn.UNICHAR(12450),D11:D16,0)
MATCH("A",D13:D16,0)
MATCH("ab",D15:D16,0)
VLOOKUP("e"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(769),D1:D16,1,FALSE)
VLOOKUP("ae",D7:D16,1,FALSE)
HLOOKUP("e"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(769),TRANSPOSE(D1:D3),1,FALSE)
_xlfn.XMATCH("e"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(769),D1:D16)
_xlfn.XMATCH("ss",D5:D16)
_xlfn.XMATCH("ae",D7:D16)
_xlfn.XMATCH(_xlfn.UNICHAR(913),D1:D16)
_xlfn.XMATCH(_xlfn.UNICHAR(1073),D1:D16)
_xlfn.XMATCH(_xlfn.UNICHAR(12354),D12:D16)
_xlfn.XMATCH("a"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(173)&"b",D15:D16)
_xlfn.XLOOKUP("e"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(769),D1:D16,D1:D16)
_xlfn.XLOOKUP("SS",D5:D16,D5:D16)
LOOKUP(_xlfn.UNICHAR(946),CHOOSE({1,2,3,4},"a","b",_xlfn.UNICHAR(945),_xlfn.UNICHAR(947)),{1,2,3,4})
LOOKUP(_xlfn.UNICHAR(20014),CHOOSE({1,2,3,4},"a",_xlfn.UNICHAR(945),_xlfn.UNICHAR(1072),_xlfn.UNICHAR(20013)),{1,2,3,4})
MATCH(_xlfn.UNICHAR(946),CHOOSE({1,2,3,4},"a","b",_xlfn.UNICHAR(945),_xlfn.UNICHAR(947)),1)
MATCH(_xlfn.UNICHAR(1074),CHOOSE({1,2,3},_xlfn.UNICHAR(1072),_xlfn.UNICHAR(1073),_xlfn.UNICHAR(1075)),1)
_xlfn.XMATCH(_xlfn.UNICHAR(946),CHOOSE({1,2,3,4},"a","b",_xlfn.UNICHAR(945),_xlfn.UNICHAR(947)),-1)
_xlfn.XMATCH(_xlfn.UNICHAR(946),CHOOSE({1,2,3,4},"a","b",_xlfn.UNICHAR(945),_xlfn.UNICHAR(947)),1)
_xlfn.XMATCH("e"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(769),CHOOSE({1,2,3},"a",_xlfn.UNICHAR(233),"z"),0,2)
# Criteria.
COUNTIF(D1:D16,_xlfn.UNICHAR(233))
COUNTIF(D1:D16,"e"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(769))
COUNTIF(D1:D16,"ss")
COUNTIF(D1:D16,"ae")
COUNTIF(D1:D16,"<b")
COUNTIF(D1:D16,">"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(1072))
COUNTIF(D1:D16,_xlfn.UNICHAR(12450))
COUNTIF(D1:D16,"a")
COUNTIF(D1:D16,"ab")
COUNTIF(D1:D16,"<>"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(945))
COUNTIF(D1:D16,"*"&_xlfn.UNICHAR(769))
COUNTIF(D1:D16,"?")
# SORT, UNIQUE and a sorted join across scripts.
_xlfn.TEXTJOIN("|",FALSE,_xlfn._xlws.SORT(D1:D16))
_xlfn.TEXTJOIN("|",FALSE,_xlfn._xlws.SORT(D1:D16,1,-1))
_xlfn.TEXTJOIN("|",FALSE,_xlfn.UNIQUE(D1:D16))
_xlfn.TEXTJOIN("|",FALSE,_xlfn._xlws.SORT({"b";"A";"e";"E";"z";"Z"}&_xlfn.UNICHAR(769)))
_xlfn.TEXTJOIN("|",FALSE,_xlfn._xlws.SORT({"b";"a";"c"}&_xlfn.UNICHAR({945;1072;20013})))
